content.description: fees.wtf is a gas cost tracking service that connects to your wallet and clearly shows the number of transactions you have made and how much they cost in Eth and USD, providing a transparent breakdown of gas charges and the overall gas spent. It lets you monitor gas expenses and failed transactions, helping you understand where costs come from. This clarity supports better cost awareness as you plan future activity. Users may collect an airdrop NFT for upcoming projects or stack WTF tokens to earn rewards.
